mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dms_admin_user (username, password_hash, salt, nickname, role_code, permissions, status) VALUES (#{username}, #{passwordHash}, #{salt}, #{nickname}, #{roleCode}, #{permissions}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE dms_admin_user SET nickname = #{nickname}, role_code = #{roleCode}, permissions = #{permissions}, status = #{status}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE dms_admin_user SET password_hash = #{passwordHash}, salt = #{salt}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE dms_admin_user SET status = #{status}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE dms_admin_user SET failed_login_count=failed_login_count+1, lock_time=CASE WHEN failed_login_count+1 >= #{lockThreshold} THEN NOW() ELSE lock_time END, update_time=NOW() WHERE id=#{id}
UPDATE dms_admin_user SET failed_login_count=0, lock_time=NULL, update_time=NOW() WHERE id=#{id}
